title: Likely flaky: the US-16 AC2d upload review's Save test failed once on CI on a PR that touched no widget code
evidence: Done 2026-11-14: a test wait, not a race. The case's open ends on screen.findByDisplayValue, and Testing Library waits with act() off (asyncWrapper), so React can leave a render in the Scheduler. In the gap's act() that task runs and commits the new tree, so onOld (line 98, expect(onOld()).toBe(true)) is false before the save fires. The open now runs it out inside act() first. Evidence: a fast clock during the open (performance.now +1..5 ms per read) failed the unfixed case at line 98 in 29 of 100 runs before H37 (fa439892b) and 19 of 100 after (main 5f1ed5d7d), and passed the fixed one 100 of 100; a Scheduler task was pending after the open in 10/10 probe runs; it failed the same way on main 43468494653 (after H37) and on 43141897972 attempt 1 (before H37); 0/30 locally on both shas. Mutation: record-session refuses() accepting another erase fails the fixed case at the written-rows check. Was: widget-src/src/components/HealthTool.erase-commit.test.tsx, the US-16 AC2d case for the upload review's Save, failed with AssertionError: expected false to be true on CI run https://github.com/DrBradStanfield/roadmap/actions/runs/43141897972 (unit (1, UTC)) for PR 1372 (head 77bda5ea1), which changed no widget code. It passed on rerun and on 3 earlier heads. Suspect a timing race under CI load (a wait or frame the test does not hold). Not a fix: find which expectation fails and what it waits on before changing anything
